# Business object context

Create one short sheet per business object only when it will help multiple features. Keep each sheet to 40 lines or fewer and include only verified, reusable facts:

- What the object represents and where its data lives
- Stable identifiers and important fields
- Relevant ownership and code entry points
- Known invariants or cross-package contracts

Do not copy feature-specific discoveries here. Add the sheet to `../index.md` when it becomes useful for feature intake.
